2609.08609.title: Dynamics of meaning: Towards the Evaluation of Diachronic Semantic Change in Sinhala
2609.08609.paper_summary: Tracking semantic change in low-resource languages across extensive historical timelines presents significant challenges due to data scarcity and the limitations of static embedding alignments. This study investigates the diachronic evolution of the Sinhala language from the 13th to the 20th century using a multi-stage computational framework. We first align century-specific Word2Vec and FastText embeddings using Similarity Matrix Based Alignment (SMA) and Orthogonal Procrustes (OP) techniques, finding that OP alignment provides more stable neighbourhood tracking for identifying temporal similarity dips. To move beyond aggregate measures, we introduce a Bidirectional Semantic Impact Pruning approach using contextualised embeddings from a fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B. By applying Leave-One-Out (LOO) diagnostics, we attempt to isolate influential sentences to distinguish between systemic semantic shifts and transient polysemic expansion. Our results show that semantic drift in the fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B is not evenly distributed across all usages. Instead, a significant part of the change is driven by a smaller set of high-impact contextual instances, rather than gradual and uniform change across all occurrences. This work provides a preliminary framework for diachronic analysis in low-resource contexts, highlighting the trade-offs between model sensitivity and data availability.
2609.08609.paper_summary_zh: 追踪低資源語言在廣泛歷史時間線中的語義變化，由於數據稀缺和靜態嵌入對齊的限制，面臨重大挑戰。 本研究探討了從13世紀到20世紀的僧伽羅語的歷時演變，使用多階段計算框架。 我們首先使用基於相似性矩陣的對齊（SMA）和正交Procrustes（OP）技術對特定世紀的Word2Vec和FastText嵌入進行對齊，發現OP對齊在識別時間相似性下降方面提供了更穩定的鄰域追蹤。 為了超越聚合度量，我們引入了一種使用從微調的Llama-3.1-8B中獲得的上下文化嵌入的雙向語義影響修剪方法。 通過應用逐一排除（LOO）診斷，我們試圖隔離影響性句子，以區分系統性語義變化和瞬態多義擴展。 我們的結果顯示，微調的Llama-3.1-8B中的語義漂移並不是均勻分佈在所有用法中。 相反，變化的顯著部分是由一小組高影響力的上下文實例驅動，而不是在所有出現中逐漸和均勻的變化。 這項工作為低資源環境中的歷時分析提供了一個初步框架，突顯了模型敏感性和數據可用性之間的權衡。
2609.08609.author: Nevidu Jayatilleke et.al.
